'''Àngel Ros Domingo''' (born 1952, [[Lleida]]) is a [[Spaniards|Spanish]] politician and statesman. He was [[List of mayors of Lleida|Mayor of Lleida]] from 2004 to 2018.<ref name=municat>{{cite web|url=http://aplicacions.municat.gencat.cat/index.php?page=consulta&mostraEns=2512070005|title=Ajuntament de Lleida|publisher=[[Generalitat of Catalonia]]|accessdate=2015-11-13}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20180804/angel-ros-renuncia-alcalde-lleida-andorra-6975905|journal=[[El Periódico de Catalunya|El Periódico]]|title=Àngel Ros renuncia oficialmente a la alcaldía de Lleida|date=2018-08-04}}</ref>

A member of the [[Socialists' Party of Catalonia]], he was its president from 2014 to 2019.

In August 2018, foreign minister [[Josep Borrell]] designated him as [[Ambassador of Spain to Andorra]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Pascual |first=Roger |date=1 August 2018 |title=Àngel Ros dejará la alcaldía de Lleida y será nombrado embajador de España en Andorra |url=https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20180801/angel-ros-lleida-andorra-6970973 |access-date=31 October 2025 |website=El Periódico |language=es}}</ref> In August 2022, at the age of 70, he formally requested to be replaced so that he could retire, which was granted to him in February 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Europa Press |first= |date=14 February 2023 |title=Ángel Ros deja de ser embajador de España en Andorra por jubilación |url=https://www.europapress.es/catalunya/andorra-01111/noticia-angel-ros-deja-ser-embajador-espana-andorra-jubilacion-20230214155330.html |access-date=31 October 2025 |website=www.europapress.es}}</ref>
